system.description: You may perform Rituals of the Ritualism discipline (the Keeper is a ritual-granting class; this class skill is the route, so no benefit pick is committed and no discipline is closed to the party). Bind your soul to Sanctuaries — small places of spiritual and historical weight, found through story; each carries a Haunt and a Ritual. In a conflict: action + 5/10/15 MP (escalating within a turn, resetting each turn) Haunts a creature you hold a Bond with — never yourself — at any distance. One creature per Sanctuary, one Sanctuary per creature; banishing is free on your turn.
